entries.jp: ……まるで
entries.en: ...It's like...

entries.jp: まるで　悪い夢を\n見ていたみたいぜよ
entries.en: It's like I was\nhavin' a bad\ndream.

entries.jp: 坂本……
entries.en: Sakamoto...

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさんのロック\nガツンと魂に響いたぜよ
entries.en: Your rock hit me\nright in the soul,\nHijizo-san!

entries.jp: ……そうか　届いたか\nこれが俺の誠（まこと）だ
entries.en:
...I see. So it
reached you. That
is my makoto--my
sincerity.

entries.jp: 龍馬くん\n大丈夫かい？
entries.en: Ryoma-kun, are\nyou okay?

entries.jp: おう！
entries.en: Yep!

entries.jp: 近藤のおっさんが遺した\n想いと　ヒジゾーさんが\n伝えてくれた誠を
entries.en:
The feelings old
man Kondo left
behind, and the
makoto Hijizo-san
passed on to me...

entries.jp: わしの魂に　きっちり\n刻みつけてきた
entries.en: I've carved 'em\ndeep into my soul.

entries.jp: もう　闇につけ込まれる\nことはないぜよ
entries.en:
The darkness
ain't ever gettin'
its hooks in me
again.

entries.jp: 信じられん\n闇から這い上がって\nくるとは……
entries.en:
Unbelievable...
That he would
crawl back up out
of the darkness...

entries.jp: 井伊\nもう　やめにするぜよ
entries.en: Ii. Let's call it\nquits.

entries.jp: 天歌で　人の心を\n抑えつけて　何が\n楽しい？
entries.en:
What's so fun
about holdin'
down people's
hearts with
Heaven's Song?

entries.jp: 天歌で　人の心を\n操ったところで\n虚しいだけぜよ
entries.en:
Controllin'
people's hearts
with Heaven's
Song is just
empty, I tell ya.

entries.jp: 金か？\n権力のためか？
entries.en: Is it money? Is it\nfor power?

entries.jp: そんなものは\n本当に大切なもんじゃ\nないだろう
entries.en: Those ain't the\nthings that truly\nmatter, are they?

entries.jp: 井伊大老\nもう終わりにしよう
entries.en: Great Elder Ii.\nLet's end this.

entries.jp: 終わり\nだと？
entries.en: End this, you say?

entries.jp: 土方　貴様はなにか\n勘違いをしていないか？
entries.en:
Hijikata, are you
not laboring
under some
misapprehension?

entries.jp: 土方だけではない\n沖田も高杉も桂も
entries.en: Not only Hijikata.\nOkita, Takasugi,\nand Katsura too.

entries.jp: そして　坂本龍馬\nお前もだ
entries.en: And you as well,\nRyoma Sakamoto.

entries.jp: 勘違い？\nどういうことじゃ？
entries.en: Misapprehension?\nWhat d'ya mean?

entries.jp: 何も終わってはいない！\n慶喜様がおられる限りは\n何も終わらぬのだ
entries.en:
Nothing is over!
So long as
Yoshinobu-sama
lives, nothing will
ever be over!

entries.jp: 慶喜様？\n将軍様のことか！
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama?\nYou mean the\nshogun!

entries.jp: 天歌泰平による\n民衆の平等……
entries.en:
The equality of
the people,
brought by
Heaven's Song
Peace...

entries.jp: それは即ち　慶喜様\n以外の命は　全て等しく\nゴミであるということよ！
entries.en:
That means that
every life other
than
Yoshinobu-sama's
is equally
garbage!

entries.jp: それは違うぜよ
entries.en: That's just wrong,\npal.

entries.jp: 何も違わぬ！
entries.en: There's nothing\nwrong with it!

entries.jp: この世のあまねく全ては\n慶喜様のためだけに\n存在しているのだ
entries.en:
Each and every
thing in this
world exists
solely for
Yoshinobu-sama's
sake.

entries.jp: ゴミはゴミらしく\n地に這いつくばれ！\n我が天歌によって
entries.en:
Garbage should
grovel in the dirt
like the garbage
it is! Beneath my
Heaven's Song!

entries.jp: まっ　待て　井伊\n話せば　きっと\nわかりあえるはずじゃ！
entries.en:
W-wait, Ii! If we
just talk, I'm sure
we can
understand each
other!

entries.jp: まずいっ！\n井伊が歌い始めやがった！
entries.en: Damn, this is bad!\nIi's started\nsinging!

entries.jp: 総司！\n天歌を抑え込むぞ！
entries.en: Soji! We'll hold\nback Heaven's\nSong!

entries.jp: はい\n土方さん
entries.en: Yes, Hijikata-san.

entries.jp: ううう……\n闇の力を取り込んで\nいるだけあって……
entries.en:
Uuugh... No
wonder, with the
power of
darkness inside
him...

entries.jp: なんて……重い力……\n潰されそう……ぐうっ
entries.en:
Such... heavy
power... I'm going
to be crushed...
Ngh!

entries.jp: 怯むな　桂さん！\nオレ様の歌で跳ね返す！
entries.en:
Don't flinch,
Katsura-san!
Yours truly's song
will bounce it
right back!

entries.jp: 貴様達に真の平等を\n与えるのが　我の使命
entries.en: It is my mission to\ngrant you all true\nequality.

entries.jp: 人々が自分の都合で\n好き放題していては\n泰平の世など望めない
entries.en:
If people do as
they please for
their own
convenience,
there can be no
hope of a
peaceful world.

entries.jp: 井伊\nそれは違う！
entries.en: Ii! You're wrong!

entries.jp: 好き勝手にワガママを\n言うのと自由にするのは\n違う！
entries.en:
Throwin' selfish
tantrums and
bein' free ain't the
same thing!

entries.jp: 喜びだけじゃない\n苦しみ　悲しみ\nそれすら分かち合って
entries.en:
Not just the joy,
but the pain and
the sorrow too...
we share it all...

entries.jp: みんなで前に進むのが\n真の泰平だろう！
entries.en:
...and move
forward together!
That's what true
peace is!

entries.jp: そんな綺麗事を認める\nわけにはいかんのだよ
entries.en: I cannot accept\nsuch pretty\nideals.

entries.jp: 解き放たれた人々が\n暴徒と化して　いずれは\n戦になるだろう
entries.en:
People set loose
will turn into
mobs, and in time
it will come to
war.

entries.jp: そんなことはない！
entries.en: That ain't so!

entries.jp: 楽しく歌って過ごす方が\n泰平だって　みんな\nわかってるはずじゃ！
entries.en:
Everybody knows
it's more peaceful
to spend your
days singin' and
havin' fun!

entries.jp: 思い上がるな！\n下郎が
entries.en: Know your place,\nyou lowly cur!

entries.jp: 我の天歌で\n真の泰平の意味を\n理解させてやろう！
entries.en:
With my Heaven's
Song, I shall make
you understand
the meaning of
true peace!

entries.jp: それこそお前の\n思い上がりじゃ！
entries.en: You're the one\nwho doesn't know\nhis place!

entries.jp: ぐっ……\nすさまじい気の応酬だ
entries.en: Ngh... What a\nfierce clash of\nspirit.

entries.jp: すごいね……\n僕達まで弾かれそうだ
entries.en: Wow... It's about\nto blow even us\naway.

entries.jp: くそっ\n後れを取るなよ\n桂さん！
entries.en: Damn it! Don't fall\nbehind,\nKatsura-san!

entries.jp: ぐっ\n目眩がして息苦しい\n晋作　龍馬くん
entries.en:
Ngh... I'm dizzy, I
can't breathe...
Shinsaku,
Ryoma-kun...

entries.jp: もう一息！\nわしらのロックで
entries.en: Just a little more!\nWith our rock...

entries.jp: 我が天歌に耐えるとは\nたいしたものだ
entries.en: To withstand my\nHeaven's Song...\nMost impressive.

entries.jp: その気迫がいつまでもつか\n見せてもらおうではないか\nははっ　はははは！
entries.en:
Let us see how
long that fighting
spirit of yours
can last. Haha,
hahahaha!

entries.jp: 暗く澱んだ気を放つ井伊と\n抑え込もうとする龍馬達の\n激しい気がぶつかり合う
entries.en:
The dark,
stagnant energy
Ii gave off
clashed against
the fierce energy
of Ryoma and the
others trying to
hold it back.

entries.jp:
そしてその歌声は
空気を震わせ
屋敷を揺らして
町へと轟いていった
entries.en:
And their singing
set the air
trembling, shook
the mansion, and
thundered out
into the town.

entries.jp: 井伊\n天歌をやめろ！
entries.en: Ii! Stop singing\nHeaven's Song!

entries.jp: 今さら命乞いか？
entries.en: Begging for your\nlife, now of all\ntimes?

entries.jp: とても暗いなにか……\nイヤなものを感じるんじゃ！
entries.en:
I'm sensin'
something real
dark... something
nasty!

entries.jp: つまらぬ言い掛かりだな
entries.en: A petty\naccusation.

entries.jp: これは　ソウちんの時と\n同じじゃ！　歌をやめないと\n魂を食われるぜよ！
entries.en:
This is just like
what happened
with So-chin! If
you don't stop
singin', your
soul's gonna get
eaten!

entries.jp: なに……？\nそんなはずはない\nあれは我が……
entries.en: What...? That\ncannot be. That is\nmy own...

entries.jp: ぐぅっ
entries.en: Gnngh!

entries.jp: ……なんだこれは？\n何か……が　我の魂を\n蝕み始めている？
entries.en:
...What is this?
Something... is
beginning to eat
away at my soul?

entries.jp: 今すぐ天歌をやめろ！
entries.en: Stop singing\nHeaven's Song\nright now!

entries.jp: ……敵に同情するとは\nつくづく愚か者だな
entries.en: ...Pitying your\nenemy. You truly\nare a fool.

entries.jp: 愚か者でも構わない！\n天歌をやめるんじゃ
entries.en:
I don't care if I'm
a fool! Just stop
singing Heaven's
Song!

entries.jp: ふっ\nこれしきのこと\n我が力でなんとでもなる
entries.en:
Hmph. Something
this trivial, my
power can handle
with ease.

entries.jp: 化け物になって\n命を落とすつもりか
entries.en: Do you mean to\nbecome a monster\nand die?

entries.jp: それで泰平の世を\n慶喜様の心の平穏を\n守れるのであれば
entries.en:
If it means
protecting a
peaceful world,
and the peace of
Yoshinobu-sama's
heart...

entries.jp: 我が命などくれてやる！
entries.en: ...then I'll gladly\ngive my life!

entries.jp: ダメじゃっ\n井伊！
entries.en: No! Ii!

entries.jp: 井伊！\nわしらの歌に耳を傾けろ\n心を向けろ！
entries.en: Ii! Lend an ear to\nour song! Open\nyour heart to it!

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさん\nソウちん\n援護を頼むぜよ
entries.en: Hijizo-san!\nSo-chin! Back me\nup!

entries.jp: 任せろ\n坂本
entries.en: Leave it to me,\nSakamoto.

entries.jp: 存分に歌って！\nトサカくん！
entries.en: Sing your heart\nout, Tosaka-kun!

entries.jp: シンディ！\nセンセーも！\n頼んだぜよ！
entries.en: Shindy! Sensei,\nyou too! I'm\ncountin' on ya!

entries.jp: オレ様を差し置いて\n頼んだもクソもあるかよ！\n死ぬ気で歌え！
entries.en:
You call on yours
truly LAST and
then say you're
counting on me!?
Like hell! Sing
like your life
depends on it!

entries.jp: 準備万端だよ！\nさあ　はじめよう
entries.en: All set! Come on,\nlet's begin.

entries.jp: その時\n五つに分かたれていた\n片魂が光を放ち始めた
entries.en:
At that moment,
the Piece Souls
that had been
split in five began
to glow.

entries.jp:
その光は
踊るように近づいて
ひとつの大きな
光に変わる
entries.en:
The lights drew
close as if
dancing, and
merged into one
great light.

entries.jp: ……これはっ！\n超魂の輝き
entries.en: ...This is...! The\nradiance of the\nUltra Soul!

entries.jp: 今こそ\n魂をひとつにして\n歌おう
entries.en: Now's the time!\nLet's sing with\nour souls as one!

entries.jp: キタキタキタぁぁぁ！\nこのリズムぜよ！\nこの音色ぜよぉぉぉおお！
entries.en:
Here it comes,
here it comes,
here it comes!
This rhythm! This
sound, I tell
yaaaa!

entries.jp: 無限の熱情がわき上がる！\n魂が震えるぜよ！\nもう止められない！
entries.en:
Endless passion's
welling up! My
soul's shakin'!
There's no
stoppin' it now!

entries.jp: 井伊！\nわしらのロックを聴け！\nわしらの歌を受けとめろ！
entries.en: Ii! Listen to our\nrock! Take in our\nsong!

entries.jp: うぉぉおおおおお！
entries.en: Whoooooaaaah!

entries.jp: これが――\nわしが――
entries.en: This is-- I am--

entries.jp: ロックじゃぁぁぁぁあああ
entries.en: ROOOOOOCK!

entries.jp: \fnt1烈（レッツ）\nロックンロォォル\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Let's rock 'n'\nrooooll!\fnt0
